title: GitHub Portfolio Search
one_liner: Semantic search engine for personal GitHub portfolios with AI agent integration
what_it_is: A tool that indexes GitHub repositories using embeddings and TF-IDF to enable semantic search, faceted filtering, and capability clustering. It exposes data via a static web UI, a REST API, and an MCP server for AI agents.
how_its_built: Python backend using sentence-transformers for embeddings and SQLite-vec for vector storage. The indexing pipeline fetches repo metadata and READMEs via GitHub API. The web UI is a static HTML/JS application consuming JSON exports. Deployment uses AWS S3, CloudFront, and Lambda for OAuth.
how_to_apply: Use it to quickly find reusable code patterns across your own projects. Integrate the MCP server into AI coding assistants like Claude Code to let them discover relevant context from your portfolio without loading all code into context. Embed the widget on personal sites.
quickstart:
git clone https://github.com/davidbmar/github-portfolio-search.git
cd github-portfolio-search
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e ".[dev]"
cp .env.example .env
ghps index <your_github_username>
ghps export
cd web && python3 -m http.server 8000
features: Semantic search using embeddings and TF-IDF across READMEs and code
Auto-clustering of repos into capability categories like Voice or AI
MCP server for AI agents to search portfolio programmatically
Faceted filtering by language, tech stack, and star count
Static web UI with shareable URLs and localStorage collections
Automated weekly reindexing via GitHub Actions
